title: Booze Cruise
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Booze Cruise,' the office embarks on a boat trip that begins as a leadership training exercise but includes humorous and chaotic moments, including a panic about the ship sinking and interactions with Captain Jack. The episode explores office relationships and Michael’s attempts at leadership and motivation.
